g.text: AISafe - Physical view (deployment on Proxmox + k3s)
k3s with the control plane on the 3 VMs: any one can be lost.
One replica of each service per VM (StatefulSets: stable names, own disk).
A virtual IP moves to another VM when its VM is lost.
The vigia turns a stopped VM back on (Proxmox API) and moves the replicas
of a VM that does not come back; a frozen VM is restarted by the watchdog.
